literal: Than doing good things to friends, more urgent indeed is securing by allying those who are estranged.
translation: Even more urgent than doing good to one's friends is to win over and ally with those who are estranged.
modern: நண்பர்களுக்கு நன்மைகளைச் செய்வதை விட, பகைவர்களை நம்முடன் சேர்த்துக் கொள்வது மிகவும் அவசரமான செயலாகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines a vital strategy in the execution of any major undertaking. While performing helpful deeds for existing friends is valuable, neutralizing opposition is a far more pressing priority. The word 'oṭṭār' refers to those who are estranged, hostile, or unaligned. By winning them over ('oṭṭi koḷal') and turning them into allies, one removes potential obstacles and secures a smoother path to success.
